==Quest information==

===Objectives===
*Speak to [[Chaplain Phyratyss]] in the [[Gate of Anguish]].

===Reward===
* [[Margonite Gemstone]]
* [[Stygian Gemstone]]
* [[Titan Gemstone]]
* [[Torment Gemstone]]

==Walkthrough==
Simply go to [[Chaplain Phyratyss]] and get your reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
'''Keeper Shafoss'''
:''"It appears that my predecessor, [[Keeper Millzesh]], was...tainted...by the foul magic that lingers in this realm. He extorted gemstones from hapless travelers in exchange for access to the [[Heart of Abaddon]]. The gemstones have been confiscated and he has been relieved of duty. Those responsible for putting him in such a position of power, have been sacked. If not for the benevolence of my superiors he'd already be swinging from the gallows. If you fell victim to his extortion, speak to [[Chaplain Phyratyss]] in the [[Gate of Anguish]] to retrieve your gems.''
{{offer dialog
|accept = I shall speak with Chaplain Phyratyss immediately.
|decline = Consider the gemstones a tip. I'm loaded.
|ask = Speak with Chaplain Phyratyss in the Gate of Anguish to recover your gemstones. }}

===Reward dialogue===
'''Chaplain Phyratyss'''
:''"I was told that [[Keeper Millzesh]] extorted gemstones from you in exchange for entry to the Heart of Abaddon. While I'm flattered that you would pay such a price to state {{sic}} my curiosity, his corruption is inexcusable. We have recovered the gems you gave him. They are rightfully yours."''

==Notes==
*Money Back Guarantee is a special quest available for [[character]]s that completed the [[Finding a Purpose]] quest before the [[Game updates/20070405|April 5, 2007 update]]. Finding a Purpose required 4 [[gemstone]]s, one of each type, to finish, which are no longer required.

==Trivia==
*The phrase given by the Chaplain ''"Those responsible for putting him in such a position of power, have been sacked"'' may be a reference to the movie [[w:Monty Python and the Holy Grail|Monty Python and the Holy Grail]].
